eps.ov: The fierce battle continues between Armored All Might and All For One. Can All Might possibly win?

eps.t: The End of an Era, and the Beginning
eps.ov: All Might receives help from an unexpected source when Stain joins him in the battle against All For One.
Bakugo is back on his feet! Can he rescue All Might from All For One, and defeat the villain in battle?
The fierce battle with Bakugo reminds All For One of his and his brother Yoichi's origins.
The balance of power shifts between Izuku and Shigaraki when the latter steals a Quirk from One For All.
Izuku attempts to forcefully transfer One For All to Shigaraki, as this might prove to be the key to victory.
Izuku dives deep into Shigaraki's mind, in search of the villain's origin: the tragic Tenko Shimura.
After All For One takes over Shigaraki's body, the heroes must fight as one big team to defeat him.

eps.t: Epilogue, The Hellish Todoroki Family: Final
eps.ov: With the long conflict over at last, the time has come to rebuild. Both on a societal and personal level.
The struggle against the villains may be over, but Izuku and Ochaco both still have internal demons to face.
How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?
